mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with interior trim painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are poor surface prep, paint peeling too soon, visible brush marks, and paint bleeding onto walls or floors. Trim is a high-touch area, so using the wrong finish or skipping primer can make it look worn quickly. If you have had a bad paint job before, ask specifically how the team prevents lap marks, missed caulk lines, and adhesion problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bad prep, the wrong paint sheen, and sloppy masking are the most common problems. Ask how the team handles sanding, priming, and edge protection before work starts.
